initial_storage_status: assumption; no measured initial water at a field
water_demand: ET0 (Kc=1) reference surface; no crop is represented
rainfall: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR, no correction; do not splice with IMERG
soil: SoilGrids mean prediction; Saxton & Rawls 2006 equations for field capacity and wilting point; organic matter estimated as SOC*1.724
burn_in: 1981-1982 climate used to spin up the water bucket; omitted from Markov counts
transition_prior: Dirichlet pseudocount 0.5 per water destination; prior is model uncertainty and not data
sparse_context: When environment-specific transition count is below 30, pool same current water state over dry/normal/wet contexts; record effective and direct sample counts.
not_available: crop-specific water/soil transition counts under observed management
crop yield response to water stress for these municipality/crop/technology combinations
local cost and current price curves needed for net return and VPL
field-calibrated crop Kc and root depth; the FAO-56 values are reference priors
crop yield, prices, costs, and VPL

crop_data_ingestion.zarc: official municipality/crop/soil/group/decendio windows are stored for current-season queried crops; action eligibility filters the annual crop scenarios by cultivar group, ZARC soil class, risk and planting decendio
crop_data_ingestion.pam: 1988-2025 municipality-by-product history is stored as yield/context; it is not used to infer a causal crop stress response or production price forecast
crop_data_ingestion.fao56: FAO-56 Kc curves and phase durations parameterize separate crop- and planting-window-conditioned derived Markov transitions when both the ZARC window and an internally consistent annual crop cycle exist; Kc=1 remains the off-crop reference demand

crop_markov_scenario.transition_index: state water×FAO phase × MAPA risk-context environment × selected crop/planting-decad
crop_markov_scenario.crop_water: Kc follows FAO-56 phase curve during the crop cycle; off-season uses Kc=1 reference demand
crop_markov_scenario.eligibility: only decendios with MAPA ZARC risk 20/30/40% for at least one municipality cultivar-group and soil-class row are emitted
crop_markov_scenario.monte_carlo: shared seasonal environment blocks and per-trajectory Dirichlet row draws; 0.5 pseudocount only on historically viable next states
crop_markov_scenario.interpretation: process-model sensitivity scenario; not observed effect, yield forecast, crop recommendation, or economic ranking
